name: Being Late
overview: Scripture addresses the challenge of being late by emphasizing the importance of vigilance, diligence, and trusting in God's perfect timing. Proverbs urges believers to rise from slothfulness instead of lingering in delay, while Isaiah encourages waiting on the LORD to renew strength and perseverance. God's eternal presence and sovereign plan, as revealed in Exodus and Jeremiah, assure us that His timing is purposeful and leads to an expected and peaceful outcome. Thus, believers are called to remain steadfast and attentive, confident that God stands among His people and directs all things according to His wisdom.
